title: Fylgja probe declaration 1
description: A file an operator writes to declare probes outside intent; the orchestrator reads it (or the FylgjaProbe kind, which only it reads) and writes the probes, sorted by name, into a blueprint's probes list. The core never reads this file: it reads probes inside a blueprint.
$comment: Each element is exactly a blueprint probe (blueprint-1.schema.json#/$defs/probe), so the declaration and the blueprint share one definition. Unlike the blueprint, the declaration's order is free: the orchestrator sorts by name when it writes the blueprint. Rules the reader holds across fields: names unique (probe.name.duplicate), gateway inside the address's prefix (probe.gateway.outside), no two endpoints on one host address (probe.address.duplicate). An empty file declares no probes.

probes_version.description: The format's version; the orchestrator's reader refuses any other.

probes.description: The declared probes; the orchestrator copies them, sorted by name, into the blueprint it writes.
